none: PAS CAM-CECBF8: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Barbarous Radiate, Copying Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: Central Bedfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy barbarous radiate, copying Tetricus I, (c.AD 275-285) (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads M A E S. Reverse shows Unclear figure standing left. Obverse legend reads [...]TETRICA. Obverse shows Radiate bust right. Die axis is 8 o'clock. Weight is 2.49g, diameter is 21mm.
